body_line_inventory.text: Companies are governed primarily by the Commercial Companies Law, with foreign investment governed by the Foreign Capital Investment Law. The LLC is the most common vehicle, and 100% foreign ownership is now permitted for most activities.
body_line_inventory.semantic_reconciliation: PENDING: snapshot preserves every original line; destination is section candidate only, not a completed no-loss assertion

body_line_inventory.text: - **Most common entity type** — Limited Liability Company (LLC)  _(Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree No. 18/2019) — https://www.sovereigngroup.com/news/how-to-set-up-an-llc-in-oman/)_
body_line_inventory.semantic_reconciliation: PENDING: snapshot preserves every original line; destination is section candidate only, not a completed no-loss assertion

body_line_inventory.text: - **Other entity types** — One Person Company (OPC/SPC), joint stock company (SAOC closed / SAOG public), partnership, joint venture, branch of a foreign company, and holding company  _(Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree No. 18/2019) — https://mawaleh.com/blog/llc-formation/)_
body_line_inventory.semantic_reconciliation: PENDING: snapshot preserves every original line; destination is section candidate only, not a completed no-loss assertion

body_line_inventory.text: - **Foreign ownership** — 100% foreign ownership permitted for most activities (subject to a restricted/negative list)  _(Foreign Capital Investment Law (Royal Decree No. 50/2019) — https://gulfcoreservices.com/blog/how-to-form-a-100-foreign-owned-company-in-oman-rules-fees-and-timeline/)_
body_line_inventory.semantic_reconciliation: PENDING: snapshot preserves every original line; destination is section candidate only, not a completed no-loss assertion

body_line_inventory.text: - **Minimum share capital (LLC, general)** — No statutory minimum for most activities; capital should be adequate for the activity ((approx — confirm by activity))  _(Foreign Capital Investment Law (Royal Decree No. 50/2019) — https://omanbss.com/what-is-the-minimum-capital-for-llc-in-oman/)_
body_line_inventory.semantic_reconciliation: PENDING: snapshot preserves every original line; destination is section candidate only, not a completed no-loss assertion

body_line_inventory.text: - **Minimum capital often required in practice (foreign-owned)** — OMR 150,000 is commonly applied for foreign-owned LLCs in certain/regulated activities OMR ((approx — confirm; varies by activity and free-zone status)) OMR  _(Foreign Capital Investment Law (Royal Decree No. 50/2019) — https://www.sovereigngroup.com/news/how-to-set-up-an-llc-in-oman/)_
body_line_inventory.semantic_reconciliation: PENDING: snapshot preserves every original line; destination is section candidate only, not a completed no-loss assertion

body_line_inventory.text: - **Number of shareholders (LLC)** — 1 (One Person Company) to a statutory maximum; typically 2 or more for a standard LLC ((approx — confirm statutory maximum))  _(Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree No. 18/2019) — https://mawaleh.com/blog/llc-formation/)_

body_line_inventory.text: - **Registration authority** — Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) — Commercial Registration  _(Commercial Register Law / MOCIIP — https://intuitconsultancy.com/company-formation-in-oman/)_

body_line_inventory.text: - **Core incorporation steps** — Reserve company name (MOCIIP); draft and notarize Memorandum & Articles of Association; obtain security clearance for foreign investors where required; register for Commercial Registration; obtain municipality/activity licenses; register with the Tax Authority and SPF  _(Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree No. 18/2019) — https://intuitconsultancy.com/company-formation-in-oman/)_

body_line_inventory.text: Accounts follow the accrual basis and international accounting standards (art. 12). Small enterprises use the cash basis unless the Authority approves another (art. 159bis 9 and following). Exempt: dividends from Omani companies and gains on securities listed in Muscat (art. 115). Shipping income of an Omani owner is exempt (art. 116). Losses carry forward for up to five years from the end of the loss year (art. 71); exempt activities cannot carry a loss (art. 72). Depreciation pools: 33 1/3% for machinery, computers, vehicles, fixtures and software; 10% for rigs; 15% for other plant (art. 90). Related-party transactions can be adjusted (art. 125). First accounting period: up to 18 months (art. 50). A register opened from January to June closes that 31 December; from July to December it closes the next 31 December (https://tms.taxoman.gov.om/portal/web/taxportal/income-tax-faqs, question 5).

body_line_inventory.text: For tax year 2026 no personal income tax applies in Oman. The Personal Income Tax Law (RD 56/2025, published 30 June 2025) takes effect on 1 January 2028 (decree art. 4). Residents are taxed on income in or outside Oman; non-residents on income arising in Oman (art. 6).
